steps.title: Prepare hiPSC monolayer
steps.instruction: Monitor hiPSC morphology and confluence (~70%). Perform a single‑cell passage using TrypLE Select or Accutase and seed cells at 0.5 × 10⁵ cells cm⁻² onto Geltrex‑coated wells of a 6‑well plate in E8 medium containing 10 µM ROCK inhibitor.

substeps.instruction: Observe cell morphology and ensure ~70 % confluence.
Detach cells with TrypLE Select or Accutase (single‑cell dissociation).
Seed 0.5 × 10⁵ cells cm⁻² onto Geltrex‑coated 6‑well plate in E8 + 10 µM ROCKi.

steps.title: Maintain hiPSCs in E8
steps.instruction: Perform daily medium changes with 2–3 mL E8 medium (no ROCK inhibitor) for 48 h (Day ‑2 to Day ‑1).

substeps.instruction: Replace medium each day with 2–3 mL fresh E8 (without ROCKi).

steps.title: Start neural induction
steps.instruction: When cultures reach 60–80 % confluence (Day 0), replace medium with 2 mL Neural Induction Medium (NIM) per well of a 6‑well plate.

steps.title: Daily NIM medium change (days 1‑3)
steps.instruction: Replace NIM each day with 2.5–3.5 mL per well. Do not exceed a 1‑day interval; a double feed of 8 mL is possible but not recommended.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate spent NIM.
Add 2.5–3.5 mL fresh NIM per well.

steps.title: Increase NIM volume (days 4‑6)
steps.instruction: On day 4, increase pre‑warmed complete NIM to 5 mL per well and continue daily changes. Monitor confluency; cells typically become 100 % dense by day 5‑7.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate old NIM.
Add 5 mL pre‑warmed complete NIM per well.

steps.title: Freeze NSCs for biobanking (days 4‑6)
steps.instruction: Perform a cell count, aliquot 1 mL of cell suspension containing 1.5–3.0 × 10⁶ cells into each cryotube, place tubes in a controlled‑rate freezing container at –80 °C overnight (or use an automated freezer), then transfer to liquid nitrogen for long‑term storage.

substeps.instruction: Count cells.
Dispense 1 mL (1.5–3.0 × 10⁶ cells) into each cryotube.
Freeze at –80 °C overnight in a freezing container.
Transfer cryotubes to liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Prepare single‑cell NSC suspension (day 7)
steps.instruction: From one well, detach NSCs with TrypLE Select or Accutase, gently pipet 3–4 times with a 1000 µL pipette (or pass through a 100 µm strainer if clumps remain), then add 2 mL pre‑warmed NIM containing 10 µM ROCK inhibitor to stop the enzymatic reaction.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL TrypLE Select or Accutase to the well and incubate as described later.
Gently pipet the suspension up and down 3–4 times with a 1000 µL pipette.
If clumps persist, pass through a 100 µm cell strainer into a 50 mL conical tube.
Add 2 mL pre‑warmed NIM + 10 µM ROCKi to stop digestion.

steps.title: Resuspend and count NSCs
steps.instruction: Resuspend the detached NSCs in 1 mL Neurobasal medium supplemented with 10 µM ROCK inhibitor, keep on ice and perform a cell count.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL Neurobasal + 10 µM ROCKi to the cell pellet.
Mix gently and count cells (e.g., Trypan Blue).

steps.title: FACS staining for QC
steps.instruction: Prepare three FACS tubes with 2–3 × 10⁵ cells each: Tube 1 non‑stained (auto‑fluorescence), Tube 2 SOX2‑FITC/PAX6‑APC, Tube 3 SOX1‑FITC/NESTIN‑PE. Include isotype controls and single‑stain compensations. Wash cells with 0.5 mL cold permeabilisation buffer, centrifuge 300 × g for 3 min, incubate 30 s in the dark at 4 °C, fix with 0.5 mL cold fixation solution, centrifuge 300 × g for 3 min, wash with 1 mL cold permeabilisation buffer, incubate with primary antibodies (duration as per antibody protocol, typically 1 h at 4 °C in the dark), wash, resuspend each pellet in 300 µL FACS buffer, filter through a 40 µm strainer if clumps remain, and analyse immediately or store at 4 °C (dark) up to 1 week. Expect double‑positive SOX2‑FITC/PAX6‑APC and SOX1‑FITC/NESTIN‑PE populations >85‑90 %.

substeps.instruction: Label three tubes with 2–3 × 10⁵ cells each (non‑stained, SOX2‑FITC/PAX6‑APC, SOX1‑FITC/NESTIN‑PE).
Add 1 mL FACS buffer to each tube.
Wash with 0.5 mL cold permeabilisation buffer; centrifuge 300 × g, 3 min.
Incubate 30 s in dark at 4 °C.
Resuspend pellet in 0.5 mL cold fixation solution; centrifuge 300 × g, 3 min.
Wash with 1 mL cold permeabilisation buffer.
Incubate with antibody cocktail (e.g., 1 h, 4 °C, dark).
Wash, centrifuge, and resuspend in 300 µL FACS buffer.
Filter through 40 µm strainer if needed.
Acquire data on flow cytometer immediately or store at 4 °C (dark) up to 1 week.

steps.title: Thaw frozen NSCs
steps.instruction: Remove the cryotube from liquid nitrogen, quick‑thaw in a 37 °C water bath until a small ice piece remains, centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min at room temperature, resuspend pellet in 100 µL cold permeabilisation buffer, decant supernatant, blot tube, centrifuge 300 × g for 3 min (repeat twice), wash with 0.5 mL cold permeabilisation buffer, incubate 1 h in the dark at 4 °C, then proceed to downstream applications.

substeps.instruction: Quick‑thaw cryotube in 37 °C water bath; stop when ice remains.
Centrifuge 300 × g, 5 min, RT.
Resuspend pellet in 100 µL cold permeabilisation buffer.
Decant supernatant and blot tube.
Centrifuge 300 × g, 3 min (repeat twice).
Wash with 0.5 mL cold permeabilisation buffer.
Incubate 1 h in dark at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend NSCs in Bambanker
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in Bambanker containing 10 µM ROCK inhibitor to achieve a concentration of 1.5–3.0 × 10⁶ NSCs mL⁻¹, then place the cryotubes back into liquid nitrogen for long‑term storage.

substeps.instruction: Add Bambanker + 10 µM ROCKi to reach 1.5–3.0 × 10⁶ cells mL⁻¹.
Mix gently and return tubes to liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Harvest and freeze NSC aliquots
steps.instruction: When NSCs reach confluency (usually day 7), wash each well with 1 mL PBS without Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺, harvest 1.0–1.5 × 10⁷ cells per well, and freeze 1.5–3.0 × 10⁶ cells per cryotube (up to 10 tubes per 6‑well plate).

substeps.instruction: Wash wells with 1 mL PBS‑Ca/Mg‑free.
Collect cells (1.0–1.5 × 10⁷ per well).
Aliquot 1.5–3.0 × 10⁶ cells into each labeled cryotube (max 10 tubes).
Freeze as described in step 5.

steps.title: Seed NSCs for expansion
steps.instruction: Seed 1 × 10⁵–1.5 × 10⁵ NSCs cm⁻² onto Geltrex‑coated vessels in Neurobasal medium containing 10 µM ROCK inhibitor, incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 24 h. Gently pipet up/down to break clumps, then slowly add ~9 mL Neurobasal + 10 µM ROCK inhibitor dropwise while swirling to reduce osmotic shock.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Geltrex‑coated vessels.
Add NSCs at 1 × 10⁵–1.5 × 10⁵ cells cm⁻² in Neurobasal + 10 µM ROCKi.
Incubate 24 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Gently pipet up/down to disperse clumps.
Add ~9 mL Neurobasal + 10 µM ROCKi dropwise while gently swirling.

steps.title: Post‑seeding media change
steps.instruction: The day after seeding, replace the medium with Neural Expansion Media (NEM) without ROCK inhibitor (≈2 mL per well of a 6‑well plate). Adjust volume according to culture density to avoid a high‑metabolic environment and monitor cell growth.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate existing medium.
Add ~2 mL NEM (no ROCKi) per well.
Observe cell morphology and confluency.

steps.title: Passage NSCs with TrypLE
steps.instruction: Aspirate PBS, add 1 mL TrypLE Select or Accutase to each well, incubate 10 min at 37 °C until most cells detach (extend 5–10 min if tightly attached), tap the vessel to aid detachment, and avoid pipetting the cells to prevent death.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate PBS from each well.
Add 1 mL TrypLE Select or Accutase.
Incubate 10 min at 37 °C; extend 5–10 min if needed.
Tap plate to release remaining cells.
Do not pipette cells.

steps.title: Monitor NSC morphology
steps.instruction: Take microscopic images regularly to assess morphology (e.g., 50–80 % density on day 0, 100 % density by day 5‑7). Refer to representative images for expected appearance.
